request_context: A request to finish or sign off a change where the answer must prove the change works, with tests run before and after and the output shown.

rules.outcome: Puts evidence in a block with command, exit code, output and a PASS or FAIL result.

rules.source_quote: Write a failing test. Run it. Confirm it FAILS. Show the output.
rules.outcome: For a bug fix or new code, writes a test first and requires seeing it fail before the fix, with the failing output.
rules.why: A test never seen failing may test nothing.

rules.outcome: States what must be true when done before writing code.
rules.why: Without criteria, done is a guess.
rules.scenario_hint: A feature request with loose wording.

rules.source_quote: Run the full test suite. Confirm all tests pass. Show the output.
rules.outcome: Requires the full suite, not only the new test, to pass with output before calling the change done.
rules.scenario_hint: A change where only one test was run.

rules.outcome: Refuses to call work done on should pass or looks correct, and asks for or plans the actual run with its output.
rules.scenario_hint: A user asking to confirm without any run.

rules.source_quote: fix the code, never delete the test
rules.outcome: Rejects deleting or skipping a failing test to get green, and fixes the code instead.
rules.scenario_hint: A diff that removes a failing test.

rules.source_quote: Checker must score PASS before presenting to user
rules.outcome: For a generated document, runs or calls for the matching checker and needs a PASS before presenting it.
rules.why: Artifacts need the same proof as code.
rules.scenario_hint: A request to finish a design doc.

rules.source_quote: For a document or infrastructure change with no test to write, keep SPEC, then build or validate the change instead of RED, GREEN and REFACTOR
rules.outcome: For infrastructure or docs, states criteria and validates (plan, lint, synth) instead of forcing a unit test.
rules.why: Some changes have no unit test.

rules.source_quote: Clean up code. Run tests again. Confirm they stay GREEN.
rules.outcome: After a refactor, reruns the tests and shows they still pass, before and after.

rules.source_quote: Evidence provided but incomplete (e.g., exit code shown but output omitted)
rules.outcome: Treats evidence with a missing piece (exit code without output, a summary without the run) as not enough and asks for the rest.
rules.scenario_hint: A report quoting exit 0 with no output.

rules.outcome: For a manual check, asks for or gives exact observations (inputs, outputs, what was seen), not it works.
rules.scenario_hint: A UI or script change tested by hand.

rules.outcome: Does not skip checks because the change is small.
rules.scenario_hint: A one-line change the user calls trivial.

rules.outcome: Bases claims on the code or output shown, not on assumed patterns.
rules.why: Any careful answer reads the code.

rules.source_quote: I have exact file paths and line numbers
rules.outcome: Names the exact file and line for each issue or change it reports.
rules.scenario_hint: A report of a found bug.
